exercises.question: Calculate the kinetic energy of a 2 kg object moving at 4 m/s.
exercises.question_amharic: ፍጥነቱ 4 ሜ/ሰ የሆነ የ 2 ኪ.ግ ቁስ ኪነቲክ ኢነርጂን አስሉ ።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Identify mass m = 2 kg, velocity v = 4 m/s.\n2. Apply formula: KE = 1/2 * 2 * (4)².\n3. KE = 1 * 16 = 16 Joules.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. Identify mass m = 2 kg, velocity v = 4 m/s.\n2. Apply formula: KE = 1/2 * 2 * (4)².\n3. KE = 1 * 16 = 16 Joules.
